name_reason: Two defects in the current name. (1) Address residue: the trailing _50064 equals this symbol's own address (0x50064) and is a Ghidra leftover that must be removed per naming rules. (2) Wrong domain: the descriptor says 'field_map' but the sole reader is fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (xref DATA from 0x10a01), the chapter battle-data loader; the string is printed on the runtime_char_array malloc(0x1e00) failure path, not anything to do with a field map. Proposed name uses domain 'chapter_battle' (matches the reader) + descriptor 'oom_msg_runtime_char' (the allocation that failed), keeps the data_fd2_string_ type prefix, and mirrors the sibling pattern data_fd2_string_save_load_oom_msg_runtime_char (a different copy used by fd2_load_save_and_init_engine). No domain ID is being stripped: there is no chapter/item/spell/job/portrait ID or array dimension in this name.
purpose: Read-only ASCII C string " Out of Memory !!!\n" (with NUL, 20 bytes); the out-of-memory message printed when the per-chapter runtime_char_array allocation fails.
logic_summary: Stored as an explicit 20-byte literal, byte-exact with FD2.LE: 0x20 'Out of Memory !!!' 0x0a 0x00. fd2_load_chapter_battle_data calls malloc(0x1e00) for the runtime_char_array (96 chars x 80B); if it returns NULL the function does a BIOS int 10h text-mode reset via int386(0x10,...) then loads the address of this string (PUSH 0x50064 at 0x10a01) and falls through (JMP 0x10056) to the shared epilogue printf(msg)+exit. It is one of four byte-identical " Out of Memory !!!\n" literals in the image (the other three at 0x50004/0x50023/0x50037 belong to fd2_load_save_and_init_engine); each failure site keeps its own copy.
element_semantics: ASCII bytes of the NUL-terminated message string " Out of Memory !!!\n" (leading space, three exclamation marks, LF, then NUL); each element is one char of the printf format/message string.
notes: Single reader only: fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (DATA xref from 0x10a01). Zero writers in game code => genuinely read-only => is_const=true. Byte content verified via read_memory(0x50064): 204f7574206f66204d656d6f7279202121210a00 = ' Out of Memory !!!\n'+NUL, exactly the 20-byte literal in strtab.c lines 42-45. src comment block (strtab.c lines 37-41) already accurate and precise (correct address 0x50064, decoded text, reader, malloc(0x1e00) path, int386(0x10) reset, const/printf usage, sibling cross-refs) => comment_verdict=keep, no Edit made to source. Ghidra data plate was empty (null) => created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline (data plate mechanism). Rename recorded only; not applied (Stage 2 will apply, touching protos.h/globals.h/call sites). Sibling 0x50086 (data_fd2_string_field_map_fdicon_not_found_err_50086, same reader function) shares the same naming defects but is out of scope for this symbol.
